# KoderHQ

> > Free step-by-step programming tutorials covering modern web frameworks (Vue.js, Svelte), systems languages (Rust, C, C#, Go), web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python), and databases (MongoDB).

KoderHQ provides beginner-friendly coding courses with hands-on tutorials across frontend frameworks, backend languages, and development tools. Tutorials cover fundamentals through advanced topics like unit testing, routing, and memory management.

## Key Topics

- Vue.js 3
- TypeScript
- JavaScript
- Rust
- C programming
- C#
- GoLang
- Python
- Svelte 3
- MongoDB
- Jest unit testing
- Vue Router
- Object-oriented programming
- Basic syntax
- Web development

## Getting Started

- [Learn to code step by step for free | KoderHQ](https://koderhq.com): Free coding tutorials: Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, C#, Go

- [Introduction to Sass & SCSS | KoderHQ](https://koderhq.com/tutorial/sass): Sass/SCSS CSS preprocessor intro: differences, syntax, and relevance
